Exact regional entries preserve their measurement when units change and remain read-only at review
Creation review fits390px mobile and1100px desktop without horizontal overflow
Confirmation saves all24 compatible strings, including Tail, removes draft data, drives sweat correctly and survives Hub reload without touching another slot
Full-body awareness accepts the completed structured appearance within the existing request limit without any provider call
An already-confirmed legacy character bypasses creation without an appearance rewrite or draft copy
